messages.text:
The best score acts strangely. A worse game can replace it, and a size I've never finished shows 0. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Fixed best scores so a completed game replaces the saved record only when it takes fewer moves. Sizes without a record now show “Best: none,” including after reload.

Verification passed: 140 unit tests and 77 browser tests, including the build and type checks.
